description: This file defines interfaces and enums related to Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM) sessions, including session management, callbacks, and key handling within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ISession
classes.description: Interface for a DRM session that can load, update, remove, and provide metadata and status about decryption keys.

classes.name: ISessionExt
classes.description: Extended interface for additional session management features like DRM headers, challenge data, and license storage.

classes.name: IAccessorOCDM
classes.description: Interface for accessing OCDM capabilities, including session creation, support checks, and secure store management.

classes.name: KeyId
classes.description: Class representing a key identifier with support for different formats, validation, and string conversion.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the stored data for the session into the CDM.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes a key message response.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes all licenses and keys associated with the session.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves keysystem-specific metadata of the session.

methods.name: Metricdata
methods.description: Retrieves keysystem-specific metric data.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Gets the current key status of the session.

methods.name: Status (with keyID)
methods.description: Gets the key status for a specific key ID.

methods.name: CreateSessionBuffer
methods.description: Creates a decryption buffer and outputs its ID.

methods.name: BufferId
methods.description: Returns the shared memory name for exchanging encrypted fragments.

methods.name: SessionId
methods.description: Returns the shared memory name for the session.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the session.

methods.name: ResetOutputProtection
methods.description: Disables output protection to indicate playback has stopped.

methods.name: SetParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter key-value pair in the CDM.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases the callback associated with the session.

methods.name: SessionIdExt
methods.description: Returns an extended session ID.

methods.name: BufferIdExt
methods.description: Returns the extended buffer ID.

methods.name: SetDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header data.

methods.name: GetChallengeDataExt
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: CancelChallengeDataExt
methods.description: Cancels the challenge data request.

methods.name: StoreLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license data and outputs a secure stop ID.

methods.name: SelectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for the session.

methods.name: CleanDecryptContext
methods.description: Cleans the decryption context.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a key system and MIME type are supported.

methods.name: Metadata (IAccessorOCDM)
methods.description: Retrieves keysystem-specific metadata.

methods.name: Metricdata (IAccessorOCDM)
methods.description: Retrieves keysystem-specific metric data.

methods.name: CreateSession (IAccessorOCDM)
methods.description: Creates a media key session with init data and CDM data.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for a key system.

methods.name: GetDrmSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the DRM system time.

methods.name: GetVersionExt
methods.description: Retrieves the version string for a key system.

methods.name: GetLdlSessionLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the LDL session limit for a key system.

methods.name: IsSecureStopEnabled
methods.description: Checks if secure stop is enabled for a key system.

methods.name: EnableSecureStop
methods.description: Enables or disables secure stop.

methods.name: ResetSecureStops
methods.description: Resets secure stops.

methods.name: GetSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: GetSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data.

methods.name: CommitSecureStop
methods.description: Commits a secure stop response.

methods.name: DeleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: DeleteSecureStore
methods.description: Deletes the secure store.

methods.name: GetKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the key store hash.

methods.name: GetSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the secure store hash.

methods.name: Length (KeyId)
methods.description: Returns the length of the key ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the key ID to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: Status (KeyId)
methods.description: Sets the key status.

methods.name: Status (getter)
methods.description: Gets the key status.
